{{Quote|Thank you so much! Now, I'll be able to make my pies again.|Yraka Nes to a spacer|<ref name="Galaxies" />}}
'''Luilris Mushroom Pie''' was made out of the [[luilris mushroom]]s of the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The [[Pie/Legends|pie]] was was [[Color/Legends|brown]] and was one of the many dishes made by the [[Myyydril]] tribe out of the native flora and fauna of the caverns.<ref name="Galaxies" />

[[Yraka Nes]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]] of the Myyydril tribe, made the pie for her fellow tribespeople to lift their spirits while their warriors were off fighting against the infestation of [[Urnsor'is]] [[Spider/Legends|spiders]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] did so with the help of a local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="Galaxies" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees}}
Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="Galaxies" /> of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Nes required more [[Mushroom/Legends|mushrooms]] as her own stock was running out. After a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] helped collect ten of them for her, she thanked the spacer by gifting one of her pies.<ref name="Galaxies" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Luilris Mushroom Pie appeared as a consumable food item in [[2005]]'s [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] expansion pack to the [[2003]] [[Sony]] Online Entertainment [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="Galaxies" /> Prior to ''Galaxies''{{'}} closure in [[2011]],<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> the item, once consumed, gave a large bonus to the player's constitution and stamina for several minutes. The player would be rewarded with the item upon gathering ten mushrooms for Yraka Nes in the "Luilris Mushrooms" quest on Kashyyyk.<ref name="Galaxies" />
